boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented HWS study environments, from library workstations to campus resource centers and late-open academic rooms.

cards.entity_name: Rosensweig Learning Commons
cards.title: Rosensweig Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Level 1, Warren Hunting Smith Library
cards.notes: Set up for collaborative work in the library’s Level 1 commons, where instruction spaces can be flexibly arranged and HWS-credentialed printing is available.
cards.short_summary: A flexible Level 1 library commons for collaborative work and printing.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS identifies the Rosensweig Learning Commons on Level 1 and says it has flexible instruction spaces plus photocopying and printing with HWS credentials.
cards.access_notes: Library facilities are maintained for the HWS community; bring current HWS identification where required.

cards.entity_name: Barron Multimedia Lab
cards.title: Barron Multimedia Lab
cards.subtitle: Off the Warren Hunting Smith Library atrium
cards.notes: Use the lab’s computers and printing for a focused work session; HWS lists this library-adjacent space as available for 24-hour study.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour study lab with computer and printing access.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS states that the Barron Multimedia Lab, located off the library atrium, provides 24-hour study with access to computers and printing.
cards.access_notes: The lab is off the library atrium; HWS states it is available for 24-hour study.

cards.entity_name: Warren Hunting Smith Library Single Carrels
cards.title: Warren Hunting Smith Library Single Carrels
cards.subtitle: Upper floors, Warren Hunting Smith Library
cards.notes: Choose an upper-floor single carrel when you want an individual workstation; HWS specifically lists carrels among the library’s study seating options.
cards.short_summary: Individual carrels on the library’s upper floors.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS says the library’s upper floors offer study seating that includes single carrels.
cards.access_notes: Library facilities are for the HWS community; only beverages in closed containers and small snacks are permitted in reading rooms and stacks.

cards.entity_name: Warren Hunting Smith Library Study Tables
cards.title: Warren Hunting Smith Library Study Tables
cards.subtitle: Upper floors, Warren Hunting Smith Library
cards.notes: Use an upper-floor table when your materials need more spread-out space; HWS includes tables among the library’s available seating and study options.
cards.short_summary: Upper-floor library tables for work that needs surface area.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS says the upper floors of Warren Hunting Smith Library provide seating and study options including tables.
cards.access_notes: Wireless access points and publicly accessible Ethernet jacks are available throughout the library; coverage can vary in book stacks.

cards.entity_name: Warren Hunting Smith Library Soft Seating
cards.title: Warren Hunting Smith Library Soft Seating
cards.subtitle: Upper floors, Warren Hunting Smith Library
cards.notes: Work from the library’s upper-floor soft seating when a less formal setup suits your reading or drafting; HWS lists it as a study option.
cards.short_summary: Soft seating among the library’s upper-floor study options.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS says the library’s upper floors provide seating and study options that include soft seating.
cards.access_notes: Use the library respectfully: HWS asks visitors to limit unnecessary phone use and be mindful of others’ quiet study.

cards.entity_name: Warren Hunting Smith Library Media Viewing Facilities
cards.title: Library Media Viewing Facilities
cards.subtitle: Upper floors, Warren Hunting Smith Library
cards.notes: Plan media-based coursework in the library’s upper-floor media-viewing facilities; confirm availability locally before relying on the space for a group session.
cards.short_summary: Upper-floor library facilities for media-based academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS states that the upper floors of Warren Hunting Smith Library include facilities for media viewing.
cards.access_notes: Library facilities are for the HWS community; confirm current availability with library staff.

cards.entity_name: Warren Hunting Smith Library Group Study Facilities
cards.title: Library Group Study Facilities
cards.subtitle: Upper floors, Warren Hunting Smith Library
cards.notes: Bring collaborators to the library’s upper-floor group-study facilities; check in with library staff if your work requires a particular room or setup.
cards.short_summary: Library facilities designated for group study.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS states that the upper floors of Warren Hunting Smith Library include group-study facilities.
cards.access_notes: Library facilities are for the HWS community; confirm current availability with library staff.

cards.entity_name: Warren Hunting Smith Library Honors Study Facilities
cards.title: Library Honors Study Facilities
cards.subtitle: Upper floors, Warren Hunting Smith Library
cards.notes: For Honors-program work, ask library staff about the upper-floor study facilities HWS identifies for Honors students and their current availability.
cards.short_summary: Upper-floor library study facilities for Honors students.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS states that the upper floors of Warren Hunting Smith Library include study facilities for students in the Honors program.
cards.access_notes: Library facilities are for the HWS community; ask library staff about current access to Honors study facilities.

cards.entity_name: Blackwell Room
cards.title: Blackwell Room
cards.subtitle: Demarest Hall
cards.notes: Use the Blackwell Room for an evening study session in Demarest Hall; HWS lists the room specifically as open for study until midnight.
cards.short_summary: A named Demarest Hall room with study access until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS lists the Blackwell Room in Demarest Hall as open for study until midnight.
cards.access_notes: HWS lists the Blackwell Room in Demarest Hall as open for study until midnight; verify exceptions or break-period changes before going.

cards.entity_name: LGBTQ+ Resource Center
cards.title: LGBTQ+ Resource Center
cards.subtitle: 402 Pulteney Street
cards.notes: Use the Resource Center as a study space during its open hours, and contact staff to arrange access for student-organization meetings or events.
cards.short_summary: A campus resource center available for study during open hours.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS encourages students to use the LGBTQ+ Resource Center at 402 Pulteney Street as a social or study space during open hours.
cards.access_notes: Available as a study space during open hours; student organizations can work with Resource Center staff to arrange meeting and event access.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Hobart William Smith Colleges, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A calm, under-21-safe first-weekend sequence that moves from campus orientation points to the lakefront and downtown Geneva.

cards.entity_name: Seneca Lake
cards.title: Start at the lake
cards.subtitle: Friday morning • HWS lakefront
cards.notes: Take a quiet first walk along the HWS lakefront and orient yourself to Seneca Lake before the weekend schedule fills up.
cards.short_summary: A low-key beginning beside the lake that frames the campus setting.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS identifies Seneca Lake as a defining part of its lakefront campus, and First Year Mentors specifically recommend watching sunrise by the lake.
cards.source_title: First Year Mentors | Hobart and William Smith Colleges
cards.access_notes: Use established campus lakefront areas and follow posted shoreline guidance.

cards.entity_name: Student Engagement Center
cards.title: Find the involvement desk
cards.subtitle: Friday morning • Scandling Center
cards.notes: Stop by Student Engagement with one interest in mind—clubs, events, leadership, or housing—and ask what is open this week.
cards.short_summary: A practical starting point for turning a campus interest into an activity.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Engagement Center in the Scandling Center helps students get involved, start clubs, plan events, and find leadership opportunities.
cards.source_title: Student Engagement Center | Hobart and William Smith Colleges
cards.access_notes: Office hours are listed as Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–5 p.m.; check the office before making a special trip.

cards.entity_name: Great Dining Hall of Saga
cards.title: Share a Saga meal
cards.subtitle: Friday lunch • Scandling Center
cards.notes: Meet a hallmate for lunch, then take a lap through the stations so dietary and grab-and-go options are easier to find later.
cards.short_summary: A straightforward shared meal at HWS’s main dining hall.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS calls Saga its main dining hall and locates it inside the Scandling Center, with vegan, vegetarian, allergen-friendly, and grab-and-go stations.
cards.access_notes: Dining access and hours may vary; consult current HWS dining information.

cards.entity_name: Hobart Quadrangle
cards.title: Cross the Quad
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • central campus
cards.notes: Use the Hobart Quadrangle as a walking checkpoint: notice the academic buildings around it and choose one place to revisit during the week.
cards.short_summary: A central-campus pause for learning the layout on foot.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS’s campus map lists the Hobart Quadrangle as a campus facility.
cards.source_title: Hobart and William Smith Colleges Campus Map
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; use open paths and respect any event setup or posted restrictions.

cards.entity_name: Warren Hunting Smith Library
cards.title: Set up a library base
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • Pulteney Street
cards.notes: Find the circulation desk and a study seat, then save the library’s hours before your first assignment or group meeting needs a home.
cards.short_summary: An early campus-navigation stop that pays off once coursework begins.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS lists Warren Hunting Smith Library as a library on Pulteney Street and publishes its facility hours.
cards.source_title: Facility Hours | Hobart and William Smith Colleges
cards.access_notes: Published hours: until 11 p.m. Friday and Saturday, and until 1 a.m. Sunday; hours can change during breaks and peak periods.

cards.entity_name: Sport and Recreation Center
cards.title: Try the recreation center
cards.subtitle: Friday evening • HWS campus
cards.notes: Bring athletic shoes and choose a low-pressure first visit: walk through, ask about recreation options, or join a scheduled activity.
cards.short_summary: A movement-focused stop with weekend hours published by HWS.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS publishes facility hours for the Sport and Recreation Center, including weekend hours.
cards.source_title: Facility Hours | Hobart and William Smith Colleges
cards.access_notes: Published weekend hours are 9 a.m.–6 p.m.; confirm the schedule and any activity requirements before going.

cards.entity_name: St. John’s Chapel
cards.title: Visit St. John’s Chapel
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning • HWS campus
cards.notes: Add the chapel to your walking route and, if it fits your interests, check the Spiritual Engagement schedule for an open gathering.
cards.short_summary: A named campus landmark with scheduled spiritual-life programming.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS’s campus map lists St. John’s Chapel/St. Mark’s Tower, and its facilities page lists recurring worship gatherings there.
cards.source_title: Facility Hours | Hobart and William Smith Colleges
cards.access_notes: The posted schedule includes Sunday Roman Catholic Mass and Holy Eucharist; participation is optional and schedules may change.

cards.entity_name: Davis Gallery at Houghton House
cards.title: Look for student art
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon • Houghton House estate
cards.notes: Walk to Houghton House and check whether the Davis Gallery has an exhibition or open hours before planning a return visit.
cards.short_summary: An arts-oriented campus stop linked to Houghton House and student work.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS identifies the Davis Gallery in Houghton House as part of the Houghton House estate alongside its art and architecture facilities.
cards.access_notes: Gallery exhibitions and public access vary; verify current exhibition details before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Lakefront Park
cards.title: Walk Geneva’s lakefront
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon • Lake Street, Geneva
cards.notes: Head downtown for the boardwalk and walking paths, pausing at the lake edge rather than treating the visit as a rushed destination.
cards.short_summary: A city-maintained waterfront walk with paths, benches, and views of Seneca Lake.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Geneva lists Lakefront Park on Lake Street with walking paths, benches, nature areas, and a playground.
cards.source_title: Lakefront Park | City of Geneva, NY
cards.access_notes: City facility amenities include walking paths and restrooms; follow posted park rules and conditions.

cards.entity_name: Smith Opera House
cards.title: Check the Smith calendar
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening • 82 Seneca Street, Geneva
cards.notes: Look over the Smith’s public event calendar with friends and choose a future film, performance, or history tour that suits your budget.
cards.short_summary: A downtown arts venue with public performances, films, and other events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Smith Opera House hosts public live theatre, concerts, community gatherings, and movie screenings in Geneva.
cards.access_notes: Event admission and timing vary; use the official calendar and ticket page for the specific program.
